text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #6f647a

g.text: Partial = the main point survives, but a consequential qualification or stance changes. Omitted = no extracted counterpart.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #6f647a

g.text: The eight-claim cap accounts for the 28 omissions. Grouping fidelity and losses by argument type have not been scored.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #887b93

g.text: These are assistant outputs, not Symphonia model calls. Grouping must be assessed against original meanings, not the number of output cards.
